editorial:
Imagine you are spending the final night at a run-down strip club in a tiny town. You have the boss and her girls just trying to close up shop for good, but things go south fast when some really scary, infected people crash the party. It starts out as a normal night of dancing and drinks, but it quickly turns into a fight for survival. You will feel the tension rise as the characters get trapped inside with monsters who just want to rip them apart. It is a gritty, bloody ride that feels like a wild party gone wrong.

The action moves fast and the gore is pretty intense, which makes it a great pick for a late-night movie marathon. Some of the acting is a bit over the top, but that actually fits the campy vibe of the film. If you love zombie-style flicks where people have to use whatever is lying around to fight back, you will enjoy this. For the best experience, you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or renting it on Apple TV to see all the blood in high detail. If you are a big horror fan, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the survivors fight a brutal battle to get out of the club. After a lot of screaming and blood, the main characters manage to take down the infected attackers using a mix of weapons and luck. The movie wraps up with the survivors escaping the nightmare, though they are scarred and exhausted. It ends on a grim note that reminds you that the world outside might be just as dangerous as the club was.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves B-movie horror and zombie fights.
